exposure: Prophylactic balloon-assisted occlusion (PBAO) of the internal iliac arteries
Preoperative prophylactic balloon-assisted occlusion (PBAO) of the internal iliac arteries
cohort: 42 patients with a diagnosis of placenta increta or percreta
finding: PBAO of the internal iliac artery prior to cesarean delivery in patients with placenta increta or percreta significantly reduced intraoperative blood loss and transfusion requirements.
